''See also: [[Nathanael Bareius Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Nathanael Bareius, also known as [[Naberius Clayborn]], is a prominent and immensely wealthy figure within the [[Aurelian Empire]]. He serves as the [[Blackwatch Guild Head|Guild Head]] of [[Kanatalia]] and is a leader within the [[Alchemist's Guild]]. Described as a bookish man with slicked-back hair, thick-rimmed glasses, and highly polished attire, he often maintains a professional, business-like demeanor even during crises. His background includes being the son of an [[Erin]] man and a [[Vandenyas]] [[Imperial clerk]], and he previously served as the keeper of the [[Imperial Palace treasury]] and as a [[Guild]] Chronicler. Bareius is characterized by his immense resources, possessing deep pockets and extensive global business connections. He maintains a private army to protect himself and utilizes various safeguards against assassination, including the consumption of regeneration [[elixirs]]. While some view him as a mythic figure or a potential future Emperor, others perceive him as a manipulative individual who prioritizes profit and peace to facilitate business. His role involves complex negotiations, managing secret dealings with [[Magisters]], and overseeing alchemical interests, though his reputation is marred by accusations of untrustworthiness and greed.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Nathanael Bareius claims to be the father of [[Bliss of the Blackwatch|Bliss]], though she does not view him as such and may seek revenge against him. He has issued orders to [[Rina]] and is a member of the group led by [[Estyr]]. Additionally, he has interacted with [[Meia]], waved to [[Shera]], and has been a subject of conversation for [[Yala the High Mason|Yala]] regarding sponsorship.}}
